name: JOTA
verdict: JOTA is the racing team's own brand; its company JOTA Motorsport Limited is owned by the Hignett family (Samuel John and Kelly Gabriella Hignett, each 25-50%). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: The team operator itself and a naming brand in Cadillac Hertz Team JOTA (per the repo's WEC convention, team-name brands are kit front sponsors). jotasport.com says Sam Hignett founded JOTA in 2000; the Companies House PSC register names Samuel John Hignett and Kelly Gabriella Hignett, each holding more than 25% but not more than 50% of shares. No state stake identified.
